name: Corfu in a day
description_md:
Corfu in a day is a one day city sightseeing walk between the city main sights. The route covers 3.4 km of walking between stops and takes about 7.3 hours for the full day, visit time at each stop included.

The day is anchored in Corfu in the country GR. This urban itinerary includes 6 sightseeing stops.
